label: Diagram 11.6
caption: Diagram 11.6 The effect of a canopy on separation distance | Roofs
description: This drawing is a section with two arrangements side by side, under the top-left heading "See para 11.12". The left, "Canopy arrangement", shows a building in section with a sloped roof to the right and a flat canopy projecting at mid-height. A dashed vertical line at left is labelled "Relevant boundary". A green two-way arrow between that line and the canopy's outer edge reads "2m min.", with a leader to "Canopy". A second green two-way arrow at the base runs from the boundary line to a vertical line labelled "Building line", captioned "Distance to relevant boundary measured from building line". The right, "Loading bay arrangement", mirrors this but the projecting element is a slab labelled "Loading platform", with the same "2m min." arrow, "Relevant boundary" line and base "Building line" caption. A NOTE below states: "Projections from the building line, such as a canopy or a loading platform, can be ignored when assessing separation distance. This does not apply where the canopy is enclosed by side walls." The green banner reads "Diagram 11.6 The effect of a canopy on separation distance".
